title: Zetta-Joule statement row
description: A small 14px label in the left four columns and a large featherlight (weight 250) statement in the right eight; stacked on phones. The label fades in letter by letter and the statement lifts and uncovers as it scrolls into view. Room for a button underneath.
notes: needs a display font with a light weight (Geist at 250 in the theme)
accent tone is for pale panels; default follows the text colour so it also works on dark bands
name: zetta-joule-statement

props.name: label
props.description: the small label in the left column; "\n" starts a new line

props.name: statement
props.description: the large light statement in the right columns

props.name: tone
props.description: default follows the text colour; accent uses the navy highlight colour (for pale-blue sections)

props.name: children
props.description: extra content under the statement (a button)
